body: As the train door opens, I step out into the crisp night air, the dim streetlights casting long shadows. I notice the dark windows of the train, a stark contrast to the vibrant colors of the city outside. My initial impulse to confront the person responsible is strong, but I pause, taking a deep breath. Instead, I think about the possible reasons for the delay and the strangerliness of the situation.
